texts.zh:
自上古之初以至今日，[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大大小小的部落第一次停下狂热内战，空前团结在一位万汗之汗下。这位统帅以超世之才与坚忍不拔之志，在战士阶级中崭露头角，并最终完成难以置信的统一大业。尽管这些部落不过是由一群狡诈、迷信又好战的物种组成，这位新近加冕的伟大可汗还是赢得了所有[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]部落的忠诚与爱戴。

既然他们已经熄灭内斗的烽火，那[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]便会将目光转向这片星河的其他地方。所有舰队聚集起来，载运着无数狂热战士。尽管他们数个月之前还是刀兵相见的敌人，但现在，他们是渴望一同对外战争扩张的同志了。
texts.en:
For the first time in recorded history, the warring factions of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have united under a single Great Khan. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has emerged from their warrior caste and accomplished what most thought impossible. Through a combination of guile, charisma and military genius, the newly crowned Great Khan has won the utter loyalty and devotion of all [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] factions.

Now that they are no longer busy killing each other, the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are turning their attention elsewhere. Great fleets are massing for war, crewed by eager warriors who are now steadfast comrades in arms despite having been mortal enemies mere months ago.

texts.zh:
我是[raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName]，是[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗，我在这里向整个星系宣布，我们即将迎来新时代。[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]为了荣耀和资源而彼此争斗的黑暗时代已经结束了。

我向我的人民保证，新建立的伟大帝国将让[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName]物种的名字永远刻在星系编年史中。

那些企图阻碍我们的人给我记好了：我将不惜一切代价让我的人民实现自己的抱负，如果你们胆敢反抗我们，[raider_khanate.GetName]必将消灭你们。
texts.en:
I am [raider_khanate.Ruler.GetName], Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and I am here to announce to the galaxy that a new age is upon us. The dark era where [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would senselessly butcher one another for scraps of resources or a misguided sense of honor has finally come to an end.

I have solemnly promised my people a new beginning through the formation of a great empire that will forever enshrine the name of the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesName] species in the annals of galactic history.

To those who would stand in our way, know this: I will stop at nothing to realize the true destiny of my people. If you oppose us, the [raider_khanate.GetName] will grind you into dust.

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

texts.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
texts.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！根据我们截获到的信息，大可汗的死因是没能抵御住名为萨拉凯利安热病的病魔侵袭，这是[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的一种常见而致命的疾病，是[raider_khanate.GetName]崛起前其太空站恶劣生活环境的遗产。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! According to intercepted communications, the Great Khan succumbed to Sarakellian Fever, a relatively common and often fatal disease found among [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a legacy of the poor living conditions on the space stations where most of them lived before the rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName].

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了! 截留到的信息显示，大可汗是被一个未知的星际势力派遣出的特种部队刺杀。目前没有任何一个政府对此事表示负责。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Intercepted communications suggest that the Great Khan was violently assassinated by a special forces team in the employ of an as yet unidentified galactic power. No government has been willing to claim responsibility for this operation.

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是在[great_khan.GetHerHis]旗舰上[great_khan.GetHerHis]的私人房间被一名外星姬妾刺杀。刺杀动机不明。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are vague, but intercepted transmissions have revealed that the Great Khan was murdered by an alien concubine in [great_khan.GetHerHis] private chambers onboard [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship. The motive is unknown.

texts.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗死了！根据目前截留到的信息，[great_khan.GetName][great_khan.GetHerHis]由于年老，在几天前无疾而终了。

尽管人们相信可汗指定了一位继承人，但[raider_khanate.GetName]还是掀起了一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主们正为了争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产——帝国的控制权而兵戎相见，究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
texts.en:
The Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead. According to intercepted transmissions, [great_khan.GetName] passed away naturally at some point during the last few days as a result of [great_khan.GetHerHis] advanced age.

It is believed that the Great Khan had appointed a designated successor, but despite this a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

texts.zh:
近期，一个处于[awakened_horde.GetName]控制下的太空居所被摧毁，这直接导致[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]历史上破天荒地团结在一位大可汗的统治之下。这位神秘的军阀以超群之才，据传是一位力量强大的灵媒，说服了[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]各族搁置争议，谋求生存。

庞大的战舰从先前隐藏的锚地中徐徐驶出，载满了[From.GetSpeciesName]的狂热战士。在大可汗的领导与鼓舞之下，他们将替死去的同胞向这片星海发起绝罚。
texts.en:
The recent destruction of one of their large void dwellings at the hands of the [awakened_horde.GetName] has prompted the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to unite under a single Great Khan for the first time in history. This mysterious warlord, who according to some accounts is a powerful psychic, has convinced the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to put aside their differences for the sake of continued survival.

Great war fleets from previously hidden anchorages are being crewed by eager [From.GetSpeciesName] warriors and restored into working order. Under the inspired leadership of their Great Khan, they now demand vengeance from the galaxy for their lost kin.
